archived_trends.name: Strategic Corporate Tax Reforms in Competitive Hubs

archived_trends.reasoning: Sovereign financial centers are actively passing corporate tax adjustments to balance OECD compliance with localized economic growth incentives.

archived_trends.name: Escalation of Unilateral and Labor-Related Tariffs
